usernames.title: TikTok usernames
usernames.description: Public TikTok usernames to collect, with or without the @ symbol. Each produces one profile result with public bio and statistics.

videoUrls.title: Public TikTok video URLs
videoUrls.description: Optional public TikTok video URLs in the form https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/id. Each produces one video result with public engagement statistics.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of successful profile or video results to save. The Actor charge limit can lower this value.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Public pages currently work from Apify data-center IPs; enable a proxy if TikTok serves a WAF challenge.
